\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, >=Stealth]
  \draw[->, gray!70] (-3.4,0)--(3.9,0) node[right, black] {$|\mathbf q|$ (one direction of $\mathbf q$)};
  \draw[->, gray!70] (0,-0.5)--(0,4.5) node[above, black] {$E = q^0$};
  \draw[figO, line width=0.9pt] (0,0)--(2.75,2.75); \draw[figO, line width=0.9pt] (0,0)--(-2.75,2.75);
  \node[figO, font=\scriptsize, rotate=-45, below] at (-1.75,1.75) {$E = |\mathbf q|$: shell for $m = 0$};
  \draw[figB, line width=1.1pt, domain=-2.6:2.6, samples=80, smooth, variable=\x] plot ({\x},{sqrt(1.69+\x*\x)});
  \node[figB, font=\scriptsize, anchor=south] at (-2.5,3.0) {mass shell $E^2 - \mathbf q^2 = m^2$};
  \draw[gray, <->] (-0.18,0)--(-0.18,1.3); \node[font=\scriptsize, left] at (-0.18,0.62) {$m$};
  \fill[figB] (1.2,1.7692) circle (2.2pt); \draw[gray, thin] (1.2,1.7692)--(3.0,1.15); \node[font=\scriptsize, figB, anchor=west] at (3.0,1.15) {on shell (a real particle)};
  \fill[figR] (0,3.55) circle (2.4pt); \node[font=\scriptsize, figR, anchor=west, align=left] at (0.15,3.75) {$\gamma^*$ of $e^+e^-\to\mu^+\mu^-$:\\ $q = (E_{\rm cm}, \mathbf 0)$, $q^2 = E_{\rm cm}^2 > 0$};
  \fill[figR] (2.6,0.0) circle (2.4pt); \node[font=\scriptsize, figR, anchor=north, align=center] at (2.6,-0.12) {$\gamma^*$ of exchange:\\ $q = (0, \mathbf p - \mathbf p')$, $q^2 < 0$};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, align=center] at (-0.95,2.45) {timelike\\ $q^2 > 0$};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, align=center] at (-2.75,0.55) {spacelike\\ $q^2 < 0$};
\end{tikzpicture}
